procedural_matters: Race Committee of Vaurien Worlds was represented by Max von Buddenbrock, Race Committee member on the pinend.
ESP 36388 was represented by Sissel Acasuso Zubizarreta.
facts: Vaurien Worlds race 10 wind was 10-12 knots with small chops.
At the preparatory signal Race Commitee displayed the black flag.
ESP 36388 was starting at the pin-end.
ESP 36388 was identified in the triangle formed by the ends oft he starting line and the first mark during the last minute before the starting signal.
ESP 36388 was scored BFD in race 10.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the Race Committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
